summary: Candidate 'SDK Initialization with Fallback' is a narrower, defensive variant of three existing peer SDK initialization skills. It implements graceful fallback logic (check→warn→init→verify→return None on failure) that should be integrated as a constraint/caution pattern across the broader initialization skills rather than persisted as a separate session_skill. The peer candidates already cover the full initialization lifecycle; this candidate adds error-handling guidance that belongs in the constraints and cautions of the existing skills, not as a distinct capability.
